summary: Ran the full pytest suite for the Bovo ASF Manager V14 branch. All 68 tests pass, including the 5 tests in test_v14_fixes.py covering the 4 reported bugs. Manually re-verified: (1) version unified — `app.__version__` == `app.version.__version__` == '1.6.0'; (2) Calendar excludes weekends — CalendarModel._index_by_day for Intervention 04/09/2026→30/09/2026 returns exactly 19 keys, none with weekday>=5; (3) PDF export contains data — test_pdf_export_inspections_shows_data & test_pdf_export_rapports_shows_data confirm inserted values ('42', 'A62', 'Hugo') appear in extracted PDF text via PyMuPDF get_text(); (4) Regression suite (test_bovo.py 40 tests, test_remember_me.py 6, test_updater.py 17) — all green.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: request mentions 'test_v4_fixes.py' but actual file is 'test_v14_fixes.py' — minor doc/typo. Not a code bug.
app/inspections.py:243 InspectionService.save_row silently drops unknown keys — could bite integrators; consider raising or logging when payload contains columns not in the spec.
The calendar weekend-filter uses `current.weekday() < 5` — French bank holidays (jours fériés) are still counted as working days. Not requested in this iteration but worth flagging for ASF context.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bovo is a CustomTkinter DESKTOP app (Windows/Linux) — no web UI, no FastAPI backend running in supervisor. Testing is done exclusively via `cd /app/bovo && python -m pytest tests/ -v`. The 5 V14 fix tests are in tests/test_v14_fixes.py. Version source of truth is app/version.py imported in app/__init__.py. PDF fix lives in app/exporter.py table_to_pdf (line_height/header_h/row_h margins). Weekend filter in app/calendar.py CalendarModel._index_by_day (weekday()<5). Note the correct test filename is test_v14_fixes.py (not test_v4_fixes.py as mentioned in the request).
rca of the issue: All 4 V14 bugs previously reported were correctly fixed by the main agent: (Bug 4 PDF empty) increasing line_height (cell_font_size+5), header_h (+14) and minimum row_h to 20pt makes insert_textbox return positive so text is drawn; verified by extracting PDF text with PyMuPDF. (Bug 2 weekends) added `if current.weekday() < 5:` guard in _index_by_day loop, verified with Sept 2026 fixture (19 weekdays, 0 weekend keys). (Version) app/__init__.py now re-exports from app.version — single source. Bug 1 (auto-update trigger at startup) and Bug 3 (history freeze) are UI/thread-lifecycle issues in CustomTkinter and are not covered by the pytest suite; the review request specifies backend-only unit test coverage on modules exporter/calendar/version, all of which pass.
